svg.title: OpenXPlay relay connection architecture
svg.desc: An iPhone connects through Android or Linux relays to a car via Browser, Carlink, Wireless Display, or Wired Display. Blue and purple particles show the respective flows. This is one route within OpenXPlay.

g.aria-label: Your iPhone. On your car display.
Four ways to your car display
Either relay. Any connection. One car display.
A part of the OpenXPlay architecture
